The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1925–1926''' was contested by 50 teams participating in five divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern, northern, southern and two western football divisions of the [[Netherlands]]. [[Sportclub Enschede|SC Enschede]] won this year's championship by beating [[MVV Maastricht]], [[Feyenoord|Feijenoord]], [[Telstar (football club)|Stormvogels]] and [[Be Quick 1887]].

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse East:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[DOTO Deventer]]
'''Eerste Klasse North:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[HSC (football club)|HSC]]
'''Eerste Klasse South:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[RFC Roermond]]
*''[[Bredania/'t Zesde]] was the result of a merger between 't Zesde and last seasons competitor Bredania''
'''Eerste Klasse West-I:'''
*Moving in from West-II: [[DFC (football club)|DFC]], [[HVV Den Haag]], [[RCH (football club)|RCH]], [[Telstar (football club)|Stormvogels]] and [[VOC (sports club)|VOC]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-II:'''
*Moving in from West-I: [[Ajax Sportsman Combinatie]], [[Feyenoord|Feijenoord]], [[HFC Haarlem]] and [[ZFC (football club)|ZFC]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[VVA/Spartaan|De Spartaan]]
